reading: This is a hero banner for a running-club landing page ("RUNCLUB"): two angled color-block shapes (one flat yellow, one orange-to-raspberry gradient) split the background, a giant hollow "09" numeral sits center, with a nav bar, a 3-line headline "NINE MILES BEFORE SUNRISE", a supporting sentence, a CTA button, a 3-row schedule list on the right, a tilted yellow badge circle reading "FREE COFFEE AFTER", and an empty input box in the lower-left.
